title: Draygar WarSmash

body:
Draygar is physically imposing, sociable and often funny. In battle he withstands danger, moves injured companions, relays warnings and puts himself between a threat and the people it would consume.

October 2024 · strength used practically

Early scenes establish that Draygar can survive punishment without being invulnerable. He rescues fallen companions, calls for medical help, and uses his body as transport and cover rather than treating endurance as permission to ignore risk. His endurance helps him bring injured companions home.

Cala and the warhammer

Draygar’s relationship with Cala is a faith expressed through action rather than naïve deference. The warhammer connects divine calling to his own judgment, while later choices show that receiving power does not end his responsibility to decide what should be done with it.

The assault on Wrath · an offer Death refuses

After Saray kills Wrath, Draygar picks up the fallen sword and throws it at Death, accusing him of bringing only death despite his talk of a beautiful world. Later, when Death refuses to give the company weapons it could use against him, Draygar proposes a trade. He holds up Cala’s radiant warhammer and asks for Olokun’s return. Saray offers her own possessions; Krone holds out his maul and asks for his new family back. Death rejects objects in exchange for souls and closes the door. Draygar answers, “Well.... Ay tried.” The exchange ends without an accepted bargain or the hammer changing hands.

Gartina · trust beyond the battlefield

Draygar and Gartina’s relationship grows through consultation, food, domestic life, and the ability to seek another person’s judgment before acting. By December 2025, Draygar’s language toward her includes “my love,” alongside their shared battle history and plans for an ordinary future.

The danger inside strength

Draygar’s willingness to go first can leave him hurt and relying on companions. At the Citadel he accepts Wren’s potions and waits while others make the passage safe. Anger and strength do not win his friends back from Death; he still has to decide what to do next. His work includes rescue, carrying information and consulting Gartina, alongside fights he cannot settle by hitting harder.

Open record

Draygar’s life before October 2024, the full origin and rules of his bond with Cala, the hammer’s full history, the beginning of his relationship with Gartina, and his later status remain incompletely recovered.

Contemporary reputation · 15 July and 30 August 2025

Ada first remembers Draygar beside Krone—the force that holds beside the force that advances—then emphasizes Draygar’s ability to calm conflict, support grieving companions, and prevent despair from becoming violence. The public record therefore remembers emotional steadiness alongside martial strength. Read the chronicler’s evidence boundary.

A forge and the Silver Star

Draygar greets the gift of the castle with delight in its stonework and a wish to put his cot beside the forge. He tells Elenia and Olokun that he intends to join the Silver Star. He also describes his connection to his ancestors and says the place gives him a sense of wonder and danger. These are his impressions and plans, rather than proof of an unseen local threat or a completed initiation.

The Citadel · making room for other people’s skills

Before the company reaches Wrath, Draygar calls for people to spread out and tells companions to disengage if they need someone else to take their place in the fight. He wants the enemy caster brought down, accepts Scribonia’s help in reaching him and angrily pursues him when he escapes. His instructions do not make him an unruffled commander; the same fight records impatience, laughter and wounds.

At the gate he urges everyone inside, drinks both potions Wren gave him and then stands back while people better suited to the task make a safe passage. A little later he accepts Bitoshi’s berries without counting them. His endurance depends on other people’s supplies and judgment as well as on his own willingness to advance. The full assault follows the company through the battle and the failed appeals afterward.

profile.personality: Draygar is boisterous, sociable, physically fearless, and frequently funny without being careless about other people’s danger. His strength is not an identity he hoards; it is a service he can offer. The same person who jokes about food and height immediately hauls fallen companions clear, calls for a medic, or puts an enormous body between danger and someone who cannot withstand it.
profile.achievements: Across Pristinia, Gael, The Before, and the campaign against Wrath, Draygar repeatedly uses his strength to rescue others. He carries the warhammer Cala, throws Wrath’s sword at Death and offers Cala’s hammer for Olokun’s return; Death rejects the proposed exchange. He earns Captain Zythienne’s promised recommendation to Captain Tarwen after the dragon-isle battle; this exchange alone does not establish formal Silver Star admission.
profile.relationships: Krone is his sworn brother and the clearest anchor of Draygar’s fellowship, while Gartina brings tenderness, trust, and the possibility of a life beyond the next battle into his record. Herb, Jon, Gareth, Melian, and many changing expedition parties know a man who makes belonging through food, ale, teasing, and immediate practical help. He is most fully himself when another person needs to be carried home.
